_help: Matt's daily light curve, anchored on bedtime and wake time. Edit, then run: python3 scripts/hue.py schedule apply. 'wake' is when the Wake up sunrise reaches full brightness (it starts wake_fade_minutes earlier); bright 'day' light starts day_starts_before_wake minutes before wake, for lamps you switch on yourself; the evening slots start 'before_bed' minutes before bedtime and each fades over fade_minutes. Kelvin: lamps go 2237-6500K, lower = more orange; white-only bathroom lamps take brightness only. 'shift' is set by: hue.py shift.
name: Bright day
